## Problem

What product, data-access, authentication, safety, or maintenance problem does this address?

## Approach

What changed, and why was this approach chosen?

Call out Supabase, authentication, environment-variable, prompt, policy, or data-flow decisions when relevant.

## Verification

### Automated

List type, lint, build, and test commands.

### Manual scenarios

Describe the synthetic scenario, expected result, and observed result for user-facing or safety-sensitive behavior.

## Data and safety impact

Does this change affect stored messages, Supabase access, authentication, crisis-language handling, or medical-behavior boundaries?

State the concrete impact and what was verified.

## Risks and limitations

Describe untested cases, prototype limitations, access-control assumptions, or safety boundaries that remain.

## References

Link API documentation, policy definitions, product requirements, or prior issues that support the implementation.

## Checklist

- [ ] Type checking, lint, and production build pass.
- [ ] Synthetic data was used for tests and screenshots.
- [ ] No service-role key or private conversation data was committed.
- [ ] Supabase policy changes were reviewed when relevant.
- [ ] Prototype limitations remain clear to users.
